summary.short: Secretaría de Energía rule, signed 4 May 2026, setting a unified expedited procedure through the Ventanilla Única de Autoconsumo for permits, studies, interconnection and surplus-sale contracts for self-consumption generation of 0.7 to 20 MW, isolated or interconnected. Binding from the business day after publication.
summary.long: Secretaría de Energía rules, signed 4 May 2026, establishing a priority, expedited and simultaneous procedure, run through the Ventanilla Única de Autoconsumo (VUA) module of the Ventanilla Energía platform, for procedures tied to self-consumption generation plants of 0.7 to 20 MW, isolated or interconnected. The procedures cover a MISSE (social impact statement) authorization by SENER, which isolated self-consumption up to 20 MW is exempt from; generation permits by the CNE; CENACE studies, admission and Registro de Activos Físicos; and CFE interconnection, service and surplus-sale contracts. Each authority has fixed working-day deadlines for admission, decisions and contract signing, for example 30 working days for a CNE permit decision after admission. Applicants who miss a deadline or receive a negative decision may continue through the Ordinary Route. Transitional provisions let pending requests move to these rules, and CFE must register the related procedures on the citizen portal within 30 working days of entry into force. The rules enter into force the business day after publication.

notes: Target IDs are not in the registry, so target_instrument_id is empty and target_text names each instrument. Internal inconsistencies: the considerandos give 02 de diciembre de 2025 as the publication date of the Disposiciones de Autoconsumo, while numeral 3.1.5 gives 12 de diciembre de 2025. Numeral 13.2.3 a) refers to 'numeral 9.2, inciso a)', which does not match the structure of section 9.2 (probably 9.2.2 a)). Numeral 9.2.1 gives two results periods (30 business days; 20 business days where the Estudio Rápido requires full studies). The abbreviation MIC is used in the body but defined only in Anexo B. The Ventanilla is called both VUA and Ventanilla de Autoconsumo. The text gives the signing date 04 de mayo de 2026 and no DOF publication date.
